content.json:
# Foundry hosted agents - per-user cost

Per-user token consumption and chargeback built from **Foundry tracing in Application Insights** and **Azure billing**. It reads no API Management data, so it covers every agent in the project whether or not its traffic is routed through a gateway.

Read the **Reconciliation** section before quoting any figure. Cost here is derived from telemetry and is only trustworthy where it ties out against the invoice.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.label: User
parameters.query: FoundryAgentUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | distinct UserId | union (print UserId = '*') | order by UserId asc

parameters.name: AgentName
parameters.label: Agent
parameters.query: FoundryAgentUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | distinct AgentName | union (print AgentName = '*') | order by AgentName asc

parameters.name: ModelName
parameters.label: Model
parameters.query: FoundryAgentUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | distinct ModelName | union (print ModelName = '*') | order by ModelName asc

content.title: Headline metrics for the selected range
content.query: FoundryAgentUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserId}) or UserId in ({UserId}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize Requests = count(), ActiveUsers = dcountif(UserId, UserId != 'unattributed'), InputTokens = sum(InputTokens), CachedInputTokens = sum(CachedInputTokens), OutputTokens = sum(OutputTokens), TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens), CostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd), SuccessRatePct = round(100.0 * countif(Success) / count(), 2), P95LatencyMs = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0) | extend CostPerRequestUsd = round(CostUsd / todouble(Requests), 6), TokensPerRequest = round(todouble(TotalTokens) / todouble(Requests), 0), CacheHitPct = iff(InputTokens > 0, round(100.0 * todouble(CachedInputTokens) / todouble(InputTokens), 2), 0.0), CostUsd = round(CostUsd, 4) | project Requests, ActiveUsers, TotalTokens, CostUsd, CostPerRequestUsd, TokensPerRequest, CacheHitPct, SuccessRatePct, P95LatencyMs | extend kv = pack_all() | mv-expand kind = array kv | project Metric = tostring(kv[0]), Value = tostring(kv[1])

content.json:
## Reconciliation against the invoice

The trust gate for everything else in this report. Each row compares the cost allocated from telemetry against what Azure actually billed for that model and day.

`reconciled` means the two agree. `untraced` means Azure billed for model usage that produced no trace, so **it cannot be attributed to any user** - that spend is invisible to every per-user panel below. `pending billing` is normal for the last day. `divergent` means the rate table or meter map is wrong.

`Factor` is the multiplier that makes allocation tie out; the chargeback table applies it.

content.title: Allocated cost vs billed cost, per model per day
content.query: FoundryAgentCost | where UsageDate {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | project UsageDate, ModelName, Status, Requests, Users, Unattributed, Unpriced, TracedTokens, BilledTokens, AllocatedUsd = round(AllocatedUsd, 6), BilledUsd = round(BilledUsd, 6), DeltaUsd = round(DeltaUsd, 6), Factor = round(Factor, 4) | order by UsageDate desc, BilledUsd desc

content.title: How much of the bill can actually be charged back
content.query: FoundryAgentCost | where UsageDate {TimeRange} | summarize BilledUsd = sum(BilledUsd), AllocatedUsd = sum(AllocatedUsd), UntracedUsd = sumif(BilledUsd, Status == 'untraced'), PendingUsd = sumif(AllocatedUsd, Status in ('pending billing', 'unbilled', 'outside billed window')) | extend AttributableSharePct = iff(BilledUsd > 0.0, round(100.0 * (BilledUsd - UntracedUsd) / BilledUsd, 2), 0.0) | project BilledUsd = round(BilledUsd, 4), AllocatedUsd = round(AllocatedUsd, 4), UntracedUsd = round(UntracedUsd, 4), NotYetBilledUsd = round(PendingUsd, 4), AttributableSharePct | extend kv = pack_all() | mv-expand kind = array kv | project Metric = tostring(kv[0]), Value = tostring(kv[1])

content.json:
## Chargeback

`AllocatedUsd` prices each request from the billed unit rate. `ChargebackUsd` additionally applies the daily reconciliation factor, so it sums to the invoice for every day that reconciled. Use `ChargebackUsd` for billing someone; use `AllocatedUsd` to understand behaviour.

content.title: Consumption and cost per user
content.query: let factors = FoundryAgentCost | project ModelName, UsageDate, Factor; let scoped = FoundryAgentUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserId}) or UserId in ({UserId}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | extend UsageDate = startofday(TimeGenerated) | lookup kind=leftouter factors on ModelName, UsageDate | extend ChargebackUsd = EstimatedCostUsd * coalesce(Factor, 1.0); let total = toscalar(scoped | summarize sum(ChargebackUsd)); scoped | summarize Requests = count(), Agents = dcount(AgentName), Models = dcount(ModelName), InputTokens = sum(InputTokens), CachedInputTokens = sum(CachedInputTokens), OutputTokens = sum(OutputTokens), TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens), AllocatedUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd), ChargebackUsd = sum(ChargebackUsd) by UserId | extend SharePct = iff(total > 0.0, round(100.0 * ChargebackUsd / total, 2), 0.0), CostPerRequestUsd = round(ChargebackUsd / todouble(Requests), 6), CacheHitPct = iff(InputTokens > 0, round(100.0 * todouble(CachedInputTokens) / todouble(InputTokens), 2), 0.0) | project UserId, Requests, Agents, Models, TotalTokens, InputTokens, OutputTokens, CacheHitPct, AllocatedUsd = round(AllocatedUsd, 6), ChargebackUsd = round(ChargebackUsd, 6), SharePct, CostPerRequestUsd | order by ChargebackUsd desc

content.title: Cost over time by user
content.query: FoundryAgentUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserId}) or UserId in ({UserId}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize CostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), UserId | order by TimeGenerated asc

content.title: Consumption and cost per agent and model
content.query: FoundryAgentUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserId}) or UserId in ({UserId}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize Requests = count(), Users = dcountif(UserId, UserId != 'unattributed'), InputTokens = sum(InputTokens), OutputTokens = sum(OutputTokens), TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens), CostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd) by AgentName, ModelName, RateSource | extend CostPerRequestUsd = round(CostUsd / todouble(Requests), 6), TokensPerRequest = round(todouble(TotalTokens) / todouble(Requests), 0), CostUsd = round(CostUsd, 6) | order by CostUsd desc

content.json:
## Cost per conversation

Only possible from tracing: a gateway sees isolated model calls, but a trace groups the turns of one session. Useful for spotting a single runaway conversation rather than a runaway user.

content.title: Most expensive conversations
content.query: FoundryAgentUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserId}) or UserId in ({UserId}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where isnotempty(SessionId) | summarize ModelCalls = count(), Turns = dcount(OperationId), TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens), CostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), UserId = take_any(UserId) by SessionId, AgentName | extend DurationMin = round(todouble(datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)) / 60.0, 1), CostPerTurnUsd = round(CostUsd / todouble(Turns), 6), CostUsd = round(CostUsd, 6) | project FirstSeen, UserId, AgentName, Turns, ModelCalls, TotalTokens, CostUsd, CostPerTurnUsd, DurationMin, SessionId | order by CostUsd desc | take 100

content.json:
## Efficiency

Cached input bills at roughly a tenth of standard input, and reasoning tokens bill as output while never being shown to the user. Both are per-user levers.

content.title: Cache hit rate and reasoning overhead per user
content.query: FoundryAgentUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserId}) or UserId in ({UserId}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize Requests = count(), InputTokens = sum(InputTokens), CachedInputTokens = sum(CachedInputTokens), OutputTokens = sum(OutputTokens), ReasoningTokens = sum(ReasoningTokens), CacheSavingsUsd = sum(CacheSavingsUsd) by UserId, AgentName | extend CacheHitPct = iff(InputTokens > 0, round(100.0 * todouble(CachedInputTokens) / todouble(InputTokens), 2), 0.0), ReasoningSharePct = iff(OutputTokens > 0, round(100.0 * todouble(ReasoningTokens) / todouble(OutputTokens), 2), 0.0), VisibleOutputTokens = OutputTokens - ReasoningTokens, CacheSavingsUsd = round(CacheSavingsUsd, 6) | project UserId, AgentName, Requests, InputTokens, CachedInputTokens, CacheHitPct, CacheSavingsUsd, OutputTokens, ReasoningTokens, VisibleOutputTokens, ReasoningSharePct | order by CacheSavingsUsd desc

content.json:
## Data quality and coverage

Every figure above is only as good as these. `Unattributed` requests emitted a token span but no user identity, so they cannot be charged to anyone. `Unpriced` requests are counted as zero dollars, which understates cost.

content.title: Coverage and trust indicators
content.query: FoundryAgentUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Requests = count(), Unattributed = countif(UserId == 'unattributed'), UnpricedRequests = countif(not(PriceKnown)), RetailPriced = countif(RateSource == 'retail'), ZeroTokenRequests = countif(TotalTokens == 0), FailedRequests = countif(not(Success)) | extend UnattributedPct = round(100.0 * todouble(Unattributed) / todouble(Requests), 2), UnpricedPct = round(100.0 * todouble(UnpricedRequests) / todouble(Requests), 2), RetailPricedPct = round(100.0 * todouble(RetailPriced) / todouble(Requests), 2)

content.title: Request audit trail (no prompt or completion content)
content.query: FoundryAgentUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserId}) or UserId in ({UserId}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | project TimeGenerated, UserId, AgentName, AgentVersion, ModelName, ModelVersion, InputTokens, CachedInputTokens, OutputTokens, ReasoningTokens, TotalTokens, EstimatedCostUsd = round(EstimatedCostUsd, 6), RateSource, Success, DurationMs, OperationId, SessionId | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 200

content.json:
## About this report

| Source | What it provides | Granularity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AppDependencies` gen_ai spans | Token counts, model, agent, latency, outcome. Emitted by the Foundry runtime for Agent-Framework agents; the research agent records its own equivalent span because the raw responses adapter emits none. | Per model call |
| `AppTraces` `user.id` | The user identity. Foundry stamps it onto every log record written inside a request scope. It is **not** present on spans, which is why the two are joined on `OperationId`. | Per request |
| **Cost Management** (`Microsoft.Consumption/usageDetails`) | The money. Billed cost and billed unit price per meter per day. Ingested daily into `FoundryBilledCost_CL` by the `billing-sync` Container Apps job (`job-billing-sync-*`, 06:20 UTC); rates are refreshed by `scripts\sync-model-prices.ps1`. | Per meter per day |

**Token quantities are never taken from billing, and money is never taken from telemetry.** Billing carries no user dimension, so it cannot attribute cost on its own; telemetry carries no price, so it cannot value anything on its own.

**Why a user can be missing.** Agents that write no log record inside the request scope (portal playground sessions, some built-in agents) produce token spans with no `user.id`. They appear as `unattributed` rather than being dropped.

**Why spend can be missing.** Model usage that produces no trace at all is invisible here and shows as `untraced` in the reconciliation table. Check that panel before assuming the report covers the whole bill.

No prompts or completions are read by any query in this workbook.

content.title: Freshness of every source
content.query: let spans = AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where isnotempty(tostring(parse_json(Properties)['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])) | summarize Latest = max(TimeGenerated), Items = count() | extend Source = '1. Token counts (Foundry gen_ai spans)', Kind = 'telemetry'; let ids = AppTraces | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where isnotempty(tostring(parse_json(Properties)['user.id'])) | summarize Latest = max(TimeGenerated), Items = count() | extend Source = '2. User attribution (platform user.id)', Kind = 'telemetry'; let bill = FoundryBilledCost | summarize Latest = max(UsageDate), Items = dcount(Meter) | extend Source = '3. Billed cost (Cost Management, via billing-sync job)', Kind = 'billing'; union spans, ids, bill | extend AgeMinutes = round(todouble(datetime_diff('minute', now(), Latest)), 0) | extend AgeDays = round(AgeMinutes / 1440.0, 1) | extend Freshness = case(Kind == 'billing' and AgeDays <= 2.0, 'current - billing lags usage by about a day', Kind == 'billing', 'stale - check the billing-sync job execution history', AgeMinutes <= 15.0, 'current', AgeMinutes <= 120.0, 'slightly behind', 'no recent traffic, or ingestion delayed') | project Source, DataAsOfUtc = Latest, AgeDays, Items, Freshness | order by Source asc
